skip.url-state: The page keeps no state in the URL on purpose: user code and data never enter a URL.
skip.back-forward: There is no URL state, so Back and Forward have nothing to restore.
skip.reset: A notebook is a document: New notebook starts a blank one, and there is no view to reset.
skip.markdown-export: The exports are .ipynb and the portable HTML copy; json-round-trip checks the .ipynb export and import.
skip.beamdswitch-export: A notebook is not a deck; the page makes no beamdswitch export.
